images.title: Perimeter of a rectangle
images.purpose: Show the four sides of a rectangle, l, b, l, b, and that their sum simplifies to 2l + 2b.
images.composition: One wide rectangle in the centre with two equation lines below it; wide white space.
exact_structure: One rectangle about twice as wide as it is tall, outlined in #2B2B2B with a very light fill.

The two long sides (top and bottom) are thick teal #0072B2 edges and each carries the letter "l"; the two short sides (left and right) are thick amber #E69F00 edges and each carries the letter "b"; 4 side labels in all.
Below the rectangle, first line "p = l + b + l + b"; second line "p = 2l + 2b" with the 2l in teal #0072B2 and the 2b in amber #E69F00.
A small grey #6B7280 down arrow sits between the two lines.
No numbers for l or b, no grid.
rejection: l and b swapped onto the wrong sides
fewer or more than 4 side labels
any number given as a length
the second line showing anything other than 2l + 2b
images.takeaway: The four sides l + b + l + b gather into 2l + 2b.
images.description: A rectangle with long sides l and short sides b, and the lines p = l + b + l + b and p = 2l + 2b.
images.context: Shown beside the rectangle perimeter example text.
images.teaching_notes: Match the two teal sides to 2l and the two amber sides to 2b.

image_decisions.why: The colours link each pair of equal sides to one term of the simplified form.
